description: The verdict record for one vetted candidate. One record per candidate per vetting run, written by the gauntlet (rawflux_results.json carries the desk-check stage; this record is the whole-run verdict). A record with final_verdict CANDIDATE is a candidate, not a discovery: confirmation needs imaging or RV, and nothing here authorises a public claim on its own.

calibration_version.description: Versioned calibration profile that produced this record, e.g. 'bulk_v1' (see calibration/). Threshold changes bump the version; records from different calibrations are never silently mixed.

ephemeris_used.description: The ephemeris the vetting actually folded on (refined period for bulk survivors — see docs/vetting-manual.md stage 2).

source.description: How the ephemeris was set, e.g. 'phase-scan refinement' or 'filed'.

filed.description: The ephemeris as filed by the screen or sweep.

final_verdict.description: Whole-run verdict. CANDIDATE means the signal survived every gate so far — it is still not a confirmed planet.

holdout_verdict.description: Leave-one-sector-out prediction test. PASS proves predictive periodicity only — a clean EB passes.

imaging.description: Centroid / difference-imaging localisation. Mandatory before any discovery claim.

blend_host_tic.description: TIC ID of the blend host, when the source is a neighbour.

offset_arcsec.description: Centroid offset from the target, arcseconds.

offset_px.description: Centroid offset from the target, pixels.

on_target.description: True when the source localises to the target star.

pipeline_git_sha.description: Short git SHA of the pipeline code that produced this record ('unknown' when git was unavailable).

rawflux_verdict.description: Desk-check verdict on the unflattened flux.

run_id.description: Unique id of the run that produced this record, e.g. 'bulk-20261114T063000Z-a1b2'.

schema_version.description: Provenance schema version of this record ('1.1').

T23_T14.description: Flat-bottom fraction. <= 0.30 is V-shaped/grazing; >= 0.50 is U-shaped.

density_flag.description: True when the fitted duration is impossible for a circular-orbit planet on this star.

tic.description: TESS Input Catalog ID (string, as written by the gauntlet tools).

timestamp_utc.description: Run start, ISO 8601 UTC. One timestamp per run.

verdict_note.description: One-paragraph human-readable justification for the final verdict, with the decisive evidence.

title: Gauntlet verdict record
